\ubblockdescription{detection.noise_threshold}{Cuts the chain's current signal at k\_sigma times its own robust noise level (\ensuremath{\sigma}\_n = median|x \ensuremath{-} median| / 0.6745, Quian Quiroga et al. 2004) and keeps the runs above it, below it or past it on either side --- no level in volts or millivolts to type, so one setting works on every channel. Tune `k\_sigma` first (4 is the paper's). Put baseline removal before it. A span scores by how many \ensuremath{\sigma}\_n past the cut it reaches; \ensuremath{\sigma}\_n and the cut in the signal's units are printed, with a warning when events are too many for the noise estimate to be trusted.}

  \ubflag{derive}{}%
}

}
\ubblockparams{detection.noise_threshold}{%
  \ubparam{k\_\allowbreak{}sigma}{4.0}{number from 0.5 to 50}{The cut, in multiples of the channel's own noise level \ensuremath{\sigma}\_n = median|x \ensuremath{-} median| / 0.6745 (4 in Quian Quiroga et al. 2004; lower finds weaker events and more false ones)}%
  \ubparam{direction}{\texttt{either}}{one of \texttt{above}, \texttt{below}, \texttt{either}}{Which side of the cut counts: `above` keeps rises past median + k\textperiodcentered{}\ensuremath{\sigma}\_n, `below` keeps drops under median \ensuremath{-} k\textperiodcentered{}\ensuremath{\sigma}\_n, `either` keeps both}%
  \ubparam{noise\_\allowbreak{}from}{\texttt{whole\_span}}{one of \texttt{whole\_span}, \texttt{rolling}}{Where \ensuremath{\sigma}\_n comes from: the whole span (the paper), or `rolling` --- a window of `noise\_window\_s` around each sample, for a channel whose noise changes over days}%
  \ubparam{noise\_\allowbreak{}window\_\allowbreak{}s}{3600.0}{number, at least 3}{Seconds in the rolling noise window (used only when noise\_from is `rolling`); make it many times longer than an event so the events stay a small fraction of each window. At least 300 samples are used whatever the sampling rate; a shorter window is raised to that, with a warning}%
  \ubparam{min\_\allowbreak{}duration\_\allowbreak{}s}{0.0}{number, at least 0}{Drop a span shorter than this many seconds (0 keeps every run, however short); applied after merging}%
  \ubparam{merge\_\allowbreak{}gap\_\allowbreak{}s}{0.0}{number, at least 0}{Join spans separated by less than this many seconds into one, scoring the max of its parts (0 never joins); applied before the duration floor}%
}
